features.name: any_numbered_list_comment
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain a numbered list (items numbered 1 and 2 in sequence, separated by newlines or double spaces)?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings; malformed/missing -> null; empty list -> 0. For each comment c, positive if re.search(r'(?:^|\n|  )\s*\(?1[.)]\s+\S', c) AND re.search(r'(?:\n|  )\s*\(?2[.)]\s+\S', c) (marker 1 then marker 2, each preceded by line start, newline or double space). Return 1 if any comment is positive else 0. Raw mechanical text matching; no semantic filtering.

h0: any_numbered_list_comment has no association with delta.
h1: Discussions with at least one numbered-list counter-argument comment have a higher rate of OP view change (delta) than those without.
note: Row-level operationalization: "counter-arguments with numbered lists" is measured as presence of at least one such comment in a discussion; per-comment persuasion is not available (no per-comment outcomes). The regex requires markers 1 and 2 in "1." or "1)" style after a newline, line start or double-space; it may miss other formats or catch non-list numbering. Comments are raw text and may include outcome announcements (e.g. delta awards), and timing is unknown. Association only.
